description: I'm Davin Hollis. After a career in the electrical trade, this channel is where I explain the fire and electrical dangers hiding in ordinary homes, the cheap fixes that actually work, and which gear is worth your money. Space heaters, power strips, smoke alarms, extension cords, backup power. If you live alone, rent, or look after a family, there's something here to check every week.
